# OpenFHE

> OpenFHE is an open-source C++17 library for fully homomorphic encryption. It implements BFV and BGV for exact integer
> arithmetic, CKKS for approximate arithmetic on real numbers, FHEW/TFHE-style Boolean circuits, threshold FHE, proxy
> re-encryption and scheme switching.

To write an application with OpenFHE, read the application guide first, then the reference for the scheme in use.
Several mistakes produce wrong results with no error, so do not write OpenFHE code from memory.

## Application guide

- [Building applications with OpenFHE](https://github.com/openfheorg/openfhe-development/blob/main/agents/README.md): workflow, scheme choice, rules that prevent most failures
- [Choosing a scheme](https://github.com/openfheorg/openfhe-development/blob/main/agents/reference/choosing-a-scheme.md): borderline cases, comparisons, depth
- [CKKS](https://github.com/openfheorg/openfhe-development/blob/main/agents/reference/ckks.md): parameters, depth, function evaluation, bootstrapping
- [BFV and BGV](https://github.com/openfheorg/openfhe-development/blob/main/agents/reference/bfv-bgv.md): plaintext modulus, packing, rotations
- [binfhe](https://github.com/openfheorg/openfhe-development/blob/main/agents/reference/binfhe.md): Boolean gates, lookup tables, sign evaluation
- [Threshold FHE and proxy re-encryption](https://github.com/openfheorg/openfhe-development/blob/main/agents/reference/multiparty.md): joint keys, partial decryption, re-encryption
- [Serialization](https://github.com/openfheorg/openfhe-development/blob/main/agents/reference/serialization.md): client and server split
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/openfheorg/openfhe-development/blob/main/agents/reference/troubleshooting.md): exceptions, wrong results, performance
- [Examples index](https://github.com/openfheorg/openfhe-development/blob/main/agents/reference/examples-index.md): which example program shows which task
- [Application template](https://github.com/openfheorg/openfhe-development/tree/main/agents/template): CMake project and starting program

## Documentation
